narrativeProgression.description: The narrator introduces the timelapse footage from Casey Station in Antarctica.
The narrator claims this footage 'blows the heliocentric model out of the water'.
He states that the footage shows the 'real sun' going across the sky.
The narrator emphasizes that by 'real' he means the sun from the 'unlit side'.
He claims the footage shows the sun's 'true size and form'.
He argues that what we usually observe is the 'lit side' of the sun.
The narrator asserts that the sun is 'a light bulb', 'electromagnetically charged'.
The footage proves that the sun is the same size as the moon and very close.
This debunks the 'space fantasy' because the sun is not '93 million miles away'.
He criticizes the 'spinning ball earth fantasy blue marble testicle'.
The timelapse footage captures a dark, circular object in the sky, the 'real sun'.
He reiterates that the other side is the 'lit side'.
The narrator concludes by saying 'heliocentrism debunked'.
